name: Product card
description: Live-shopping card: product picture, name, price with the old price struck through, a discount badge, an optional offer countdown and a stock bar.

params.name: picture
params.help: Product picture: an https address or a data:image URI (empty: no picture)

params.name: price
params.help: Price as shown, e.g. $79 or 79,00 EUR

params.name: old_price
params.help: Earlier price, shown struck through (empty: none)

params.name: badge
params.help: Short badge, e.g. -20% or NEW (empty: none)

params.name: offer_until
params.help: Offer ends at this time (18:30 or 2026-12-31T18:30); wins over offer_duration

params.name: offer_duration
params.help: Or the offer runs this long from when it is shown (seconds or m:ss; 0 and no time: no countdown)

params.name: stock_left
params.help: Items left (shown when stock_total is above 0)

params.name: stock_total
params.help: Items at the start, for the stock bar (0: no stock bar)

params.name: cta
params.help: Call to action at the bottom, e.g. Link in the description (empty: none)
